sermon.title: Does Satan Rule in the Kingdoms of Men and Should Christians Get Involved?
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: God is the final authority over governments; He raises up and removes kings and holds the king’s heart in His hand. Separation of church and state should not mean separating Christ’s moral laws from the nation, and God can call Christians into government.

chunks.section_question: Who has the final say over governments?
chunks.short_answer: Not parties, voters or Satan—Jesus told Pilate he would have no authority unless it were given from above.
chunks.text: Daniel said in the last days the house of God is going to be built in troublous times difficult times. The wicked will not understand. But the righteous will understand. All the world’s governments throughout the world where is their final source of power is it the democrat republican party in the usa. Is it the voters that vote for them. Is it socialism or communism in their nations. By military revolution. Is they dictators of monarchs and third world nations who really has the final say is it Satan. Ruling in the kingdom of men as many Christians believe they believe that the answer is found in John 19 verse 11 Jesus said to Pilate the roman delegated governor of Judea.

chunks.short_answer: They prayed daily; today’s politicians try to solve the pandemic and economy on their own instead of calling on God.

When they found this nation and developed the constitution they prayed every day but our politicians aren’t praying they’re trying to solve this pandemic and economic problems all on their own none are suggesting that they get on their knees and call on a God who has the final say in any nation it is not the supreme court it is not congress it is not president Jesus Christ himself has the final say enough way would get on their knees and pray like Benjamin Franklin and those guys did back there we could have some answers today.

chunks.section_question: Why get involved if God decides?
chunks.short_answer: God removes and raises up kings, not Satan; all authority is from God and the king’s heart is in His hand.
chunks.text: If God decides who rules. Why get involved. Satan says all kingdoms are mine to give to whomsoever I want and the wealth of them. If God’s the final authority. Decision maker and he’s given Satan over the kingdoms why should I get involved. Daniel chapter 2 verse 21 God removes kings and raises up kings not Satan. In Romans 13:1 there is no government authority. No government authority except from God and appointed by God not Satan. God. Proverbs 21:1. The king’s heart. Is in the hand of the Lord.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And the devil said to Him, “All this authority I will give You, and their glory; for this has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I wish.
And He changes the times and the seasons; He removes kings and raises up kings; He gives wisdom to the wise And knowledge to those who have understanding.
Let every soul be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist are appointed by God.
The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, Like the rivers of water; He turns it wherever He wishes.

chunks.section_question: What is wrong with church-state separation as taught?
chunks.short_answer: It becomes Christ and Bible separation; we want Christ’s moral laws, not Catholics or Protestants, running America.
chunks.text: Like rivers of water he turns that heart wherever he wishes. So God is saying I have the power I have the authority. To change government’s thinking government’s heart government’s ways now why would not a congress. And most of them claim to be Christians not be calling for times of prayer every day instead of all that arguing going on in congress if they got on their knees and applied their christianity. I submit to you they would get some answers from above and change this nation. A lot of denominations. Do not believe in political involvement in America. They believe Satan rules the nations a lot of them teach church and state separation.

chunks.section_question: Can God call Christians to government?
chunks.short_answer: Yes—God designed government and rule by law; young people should study law and political science and get involved.

faqs.question: What did Jesus tell Pilate?
faqs.answer: He would have no authority unless it were given from above.

faqs.question: Who is the final deciding factor?
What did Satan claim?
faqs.answer: That all kingdoms were his to give.

faqs.question: Who removes and raises up kings?
Where is the king’s heart?
faqs.answer: In the hand of the Lord.

faqs.question: What should young people consider?
faqs.answer: Becoming lawyers, studying political science and entering government.
